items.name: 信号复现过程
items.definition: 在采样控制系统中，把脉冲序列转变为连续信号的过程称为信号复现过程。

items.name: Compensation
items.definition: Compensation：The alteration or adjustment of a control system in order to provide a suitable performance

items.name: Discrete design
items.definition: Discrete design：A technique for finding difference equations directly without designing D_c(s) first.

items.name: Circle Criterion
items.definition: Circle Criterion：A frequency-response-based stability method that considers the energy seen at the terminals of the system

items.name: D/A转换器
items.definition: D/A 转换器是把离散的数字信号转换为连续模拟信号的装置。
